annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and finite-sum form of Lemma 2.2's lower bound

assumptions: The interpolation value at the fixed evaluation point is nonzero.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P13 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P13 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p13_t1_condition_ge_one {n : Nat} (ell f : Fin n -> Real) (hvalue : p13InterpolationValue ell f != 0) : 1 <= p13Condition ell f
formal_statement.plain_language: Higham's componentwise interpolation condition number is at least one whenever the interpolated value is nonzero.

informal_proof: Apply the triangle inequality to the finite interpolation sum and divide by the positive magnitude of its nonzero value.
informal_statement: The lower-bound clause of Lemma 2.2, equation (2.2).
